records.title: Valmikinagar Airport Under Udan Scheme
details: b: Valmikinagar Airport in Bihar has been identified for development and operationalisation of RCS flights under the UDAN Scheme and an amount of Rs. 25 Crores has been allocated under the Revival of unserved airstrips Scheme.

records.title: Status of National Waterway Number 37
details: d): The updation of Detailed Project Report (DPR) has been taken up through M/s Rail India Technical and Economic Service (RITES) Ltd. for exploring the possibilities of Inland Water Transport (IWT) development based on economical and social viability.

details: I WILL GATHER ALL THE DETAILS AND PROVIDE THEM TO THE HON'BLE MEMBER OF THE PARLIAMENT SOON.

records.title: Four Laning of NH-727
details: a to d: The Government in the Ministry of Road Transport & Highway has taken up preparation of Detailed Project Report (DPR) of Chapwa-Bettiah-Bagaha section (90 km) of National highway (NH)-727 which is at present of 2 lane NH standards. The bids for DPR consultancy for Chapwa- Bettiah section have been invited. The consultant has been appointed for preparation of DPR of Bettiah-Bagaha section.
